verdict.rationale: The SDK is an open-source Python/JS library that engineering teams host and run themselves (Runner class executes agents in your own process), and it is explicitly provider-agnostic, supporting 100+ LLMs beyond OpenAI's own APIs, which supports infrastructure independence. However, several built-in features (tracing dashboard, OpenAI-managed tools like web/file search, hosted MCP) are OpenAI-platform-dependent by default, and there is no explicit doc/guide on disabling telemetry or a documented fully-vendor-free deployment pattern. missing for 10: explicit self-hosting/deployment guide, documentation on opting out of OpenAI tracing telemetry, independent verification of running fully vendor-free in production.
